BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enhancing consumer privacy by limiting access tobirth certificates; and adding a new section to chapter 70.58 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.58 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In addition to the requirements in RCW 70.58.082: (1) The department shall not provide access to a birth certificatethat is less than one hundred twentyfive years old unless therequester is one of the following: (a) The person named on the birthcertificate; (b) the legal parent or guardian of the person named onthe birth certificate; (c) a person or entity with a court order; or(d) a person that is accessing the birth certificate for researchpurposes as provided under chapter 42.48 RCW. (2) The department shall require that every person requesting acopy of a birth certificate or access to a birth certificate provideproof that he or she is authorized to do so under subsection (1) ofthis section. p. 1 SB 5845 (3) The department shall adopt rules to implement this section.
